decisive_items: symmetric pain in the small joints of her hands, wrists, knees, and ankles
anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody of 237.39 units (normal <20 units)
MRI of the hands demonstrated synovitis of the bilateral distal radioulnar joints and the left second metacarpophalangeal joint, with tenosynovitis around the extensor carpi ulnaris tendon
response.rationale: Symmetric inflammatory polyarthritis with morning stiffness, positive RF and highly specific anti-CCP, and MRI synovitis/tenosynovitis meet RA criteria; ANA positivity without ENA/dsDNA and recent COVID are nonspecific/incidental.

rejected.why: ANA positivity alone is nonspecific; positive anti-CCP and RF with symmetric synovitis establish RA rather than undifferentiated disease.
ANA is positive but ENA and dsDNA are negative and there are no systemic lupus features; anti-CCP-positive symmetric synovitis favors RA.
COVID occurred after symptom onset and reactive arthritis does not explain positive anti-CCP/RF or symmetric small-joint synovitis; no GU/GI infection.
